_comment: Elimination half-lives (minutes) verified against the paper they are cited to, written by pipeline/audit/halflife_from_primary.py --write. DrugBank names the paper; the value and the citation both come from the paper itself, and `quote` is the sentence that carries it so the claim can be re-checked without re-deriving how it was found. Add rows by re-running the tool, never by hand: a hand-written row is a number with a citation attached to it rather than one taken from the citation.

entries.quote: In later multiple-dose studies in which doxazosin concentrations were measured beyond 24 hours after administration, the terminal elimination half-life was 22 hours.
After IV administration, hydrocortisone was eliminated with a total body clearance of 18 L/hr and a half-life of 1.7 hr.
Following i.v. administration pyrantel was quickly cleared from the bloodstream, exhibiting a terminal half-life of 1.75 ± 0.19 h and a residence time (MRT) of 2.54 ± 0.27 h.
